name: lsp
description: Completions, diagnostics, hover, go to definition, rename, formatting and more via the Language Server Protocol.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Add or override language servers: { "name": { "command": ["bin", "--stdio"], "extensions": ["ext"], "settings": {}, "disabled": false } }. Built-in names: typescript, python, rust, go, c, css, html, json, bash, yaml, lua, ruby, php, zig, svelte.

formatOnSave.title: Format on Save
formatOnSave.description: Ask the language server to format a file before saving it.

modClickGoesToDefinition.title: ⌘/Ctrl-Click Goes to Definition
modClickGoesToDefinition.description: When on, Alt-click adds cursors instead.

signatureHelp.title: Signature Help
signatureHelp.description: Show parameter hints while typing a call.

promptToInstall.title: Suggest Installing Servers
promptToInstall.description: Show install instructions when a file has a known server that isn't installed.

trace.title: Trace Protocol
trace.description: Log every JSON-RPC message to the Language Servers panel.
